title: Choreo Autonomous
description: Draw two paths in Choreo, then write the autonomous routine the way the competition robot does: follow the first path, pick up, follow the second path, aim at the goal with the aim state you built, and shoot.

checkpoints.title: Two paths drawn
checkpoints.description: The Choreo project has two paths that you generated, each with at least three waypoints (a start, a point in between, and an end).

checkpoints.title: Paths named ToPickup and ToScore
checkpoints.description: The paths are named ToPickup and ToScore, and Autos.java loads them by those names.

checkpoints.title: Paths go where they should
checkpoints.description: ToPickup starts on the Start point and ends on the Pickup point, and ToScore starts where ToPickup ended and ends on the ScoreSpot point (each within about 30 centimeters, the join within 15).

checkpoints.title: Autonomous sequence written
checkpoints.description: Autos.java drives ToPickup, then ToScore, then aims at the goal (until isAimed), then shoots, in that order.

checkpoints.title: Reaches the pickup
checkpoints.description: Run Pickup And Score in Auto. The robot, measured by its true position in the simulator, should get within 0.4 meters of the Pickup point.

checkpoints.title: Reaches the scoring spot
checkpoints.description: Run Pickup And Score in Auto. The robot, measured by its true position, should get within 0.4 meters of the ScoreSpot point.

checkpoints.title: Aims before it shoots
checkpoints.description: Every shot should start with the robot truly facing the goal, within 5 degrees. Aim (until isAimed) before you shoot.

checkpoints.title: Shoots
checkpoints.description: The routine should end by shooting at least once.
